desc: Implement the full solution in the starter code: map each boundary point to a unique clockwise perimeter coordinate, sort, binary search D, use two-pointer next and greedy jumps, and include the three example asserts.

Validate the implementation by running the three provided examples and a brute-force cross-check on small random cases (side <= 4, all boundary integer points, random subsets, k from 4 to min(n,25)); compare maxDistance with exhaustive selection and fix any failures.
